content.text: ▪︎Cushing dz: ACTH-secreting pituitary tumor (MC adenoma, rarely carcinoma); ~3x more common in ♀
▪︎excess cortisol → abnl fat deposition, ⇡androgens + aldosterone, ⇡protein catabolism (vs Addison: ⇣androgens, ⇣aldo, protein anabolism)
•epidermal hyperplasia & thickening of the skin esp. around neck/armpit w/ hyperinsulinemia
▪︎fatigue, ⇣endurance; protuberant abd; striae around thighs, breasts, abd; proximal musc atrophy + weakness

▪︎also: osteoporosis, AVN, acne, superficial skin infections, opportunistic bact/fungal infections (ex, recurrent yeast), polyuria, oligo/amenorrhea (♀), ED (♂), dark facial hair (♀), cardiac hypertrophy
▪︎psych: inability to concentrate, mood lability, depressive Sx, frank psychosis
▪︎late-night salivary cortisol: consistently ⇡ = sensitive + specific (cortisol nl lower in evening)
▪︎Cushing dz: >50% suppression (pituitary adenomas only partially resistant to glucocorticoid neg feedback)
▪︎pituitary adenoma >6mm + high-dose DST + CRH c/w Cushing dz → ⍉further testing

▪︎DST interference: CYP3A4 inducers ⇡dexamethasone metabolism → impaired cortisol suppression: anticonvulsants (phenytoin, phenobarbital, carbamazepine, primidone, ethosuximide), rifamycins (rifampin, rifapentine), St. John's wort, pioglitazone, dabrafenib
▪︎postop: empiric hydrocortisone (cortisol withdrawal Sx), taper slowly
▪︎⍉surg candidate → ⇣cortisol meds: cabergoline, ketoconazole, metyrapone; pasireotide = refractory ACTH-secreting pituitary tumors
